identifierPolicy: Stable lower_snake_case IDs identify ingredient form and relevant composition. Synonyms are aliases; culinary substitutions are not aliases. Retire IDs with explicit mappings rather than silently changing meaning.

quantityConventions.recipeIngredients: Whole-recipe edible quantities for the stated servings, not per-serving amounts.
quantityConventions.substitutionAlternatives: Whole-recipe replacement quantities for one original ingredient. Apply one alternative at a time, never all alternatives together.
quantityConventions.possibleAddOns: Whole-recipe additional quantities. Excluded from base nutrition.
quantityConventions.possibleRemovals: Whole-recipe quantities of existing ingredient lines to remove. Recalculate the result.
quantityConventions.scalingChanges: Per-serving deltas to the original base. The three goals are independent options, not a sequence.
quantityConventions.dryGrains: Rice, pasta, barley, bulgur, couscous, buckwheat, oats and dried red lentils are dry unless the ID and quantityState explicitly say otherwise.
quantityConventions.cannedFood: Canned beans, lentils, corn, fruit and tuna use drained edible weight. Canned tomatoes and passata include their sauce or juice.
quantityConventions.eggs: Edible shell-free grams; an approximate egg count in notes is a kitchen aid, not a reliable purchase conversion.
quantityConventions.frozenVegetables: Weigh frozen before cooking unless a recipe note says otherwise; water lost during cooking is not subtracted from the generic nutrition sum.
quantityConventions.preparedStock: Stock quantities are prepared millilitres, not concentrate, powder or cube weight.
quantityConventions.cookingWater: Quantified absorption or recipe water is listed. Unmeasured water used only to rinse, boil and drain is a utility, not a grocery ingredient.
quantityConventions.density: No automatic g/ml conversion. Match basis units or obtain a verified SKU-specific density.
quantityConventions.purchaseYield: Edible quantities are not package quantities. Use verified drained weights, peel/bone yields, count weights and pack sizes when buying.

nutritionModel.referenceBasis: Per 100 g or per 100 ml, exactly as specified for each canonical ingredient.
nutritionModel.recipeCalculation: Sum ingredient quantity / reference basisQuantity * reference nutrients; divide by servings; exclude optional ingredients.
nutritionModel.rounding: Reference energy to 0.1 kcal; sum with decimal arithmetic; round recipe energy to whole kcal and other recipe nutrients to 0.1 g, using ROUND_HALF_UP. Round only after summing.
limitations: Rounded author-curated generic estimates, not laboratory or branded-product measurements.
All measured oil, marinade, coatings and sauces are counted as eaten unless an ingredient is optional; actual retention can differ.
Cooking losses, trimming differences, mineral losses and measured cooked yields are not modeled.
Energy from organic acids, alcohol, polyols and other special Annex XIV factors is not modeled separately.
Do not treat this carbohydrate field as US total carbohydrate; US totals generally include fibre.
These estimates have no measured confidence interval and do not justify an invented precision claim.
nutritionModel.productionRequirement: Replace or validate generic references against licensed authoritative composition records and actual retailer SKU labels before calibrated dietary planning; retain source IDs, basis, version and provenance.

offerMatchingRules: Match a retailer SKU to one canonical ID using form, cut, bone/skin state, fat class, flavour, allergens, drainage state and ingredient constraints, not a fuzzy name alone.
Record fat or protein differences as an explicit product-variant nutrition override; do not silently equate 5% and 15% mince or Greek-style yogurt and high-protein strained yogurt.
Use the SKU label for allergen and vegetarian suitability checks, including compound ingredients and cross-contact.
Convert prepared stock to the purchased concentrate only using that product dilution instructions.
Compute edible unit cost from usable pack content. Aggregate whole-week ingredient demand before calculating whole-pack purchases and leftovers.
Apply offer dates, store, membership conditions, pack limits, geography, price currency and source timestamp. None of these data is included in this release.
After a substitution, re-evaluate ingredient demand, nutrients, energy, allergens, dietary suitability, tags, method, time, taste and costs. Method-changing alternatives require review.
